name: Governance Forum
description: The forum inventory (02-data-model.md §6.2). The master record every other module links to rather than copies. Its workflow state is compliance_status; all logic reads the semantic flags below, never the label.

fields.label: Forum Name
fields.description: The forum's business name. Its identifier is the record key, a naming series — the forum_id of the data model.

fields.label: Mandate
fields.description: The forum's mandate. A watched field: changing it sends the forum back for compliance review.

fields.label: Cadence
fields.options:
Weekly
Bi-Weekly
Monthly
Bi-Monthly
Quarterly
Semi-Annually
Annually
Ad Hoc

fields.label: Committee Chair
fields.description: Derived from the active chair membership. The membership record is authoritative; this field is maintained by one code path and is never edited directly.

fields.label: Secretary
fields.description: Derived from the active secretary membership.

fields.label: Forum Owner
fields.description: Derived from the active owner membership. Accountable for accuracy and attestation, distinct from the chair.

fields.label: Compliance Contact
fields.description: The compliance counter-signatory for the annual dual-signed owner and compliance review. Not in 02-data-model.md §6.2; the dual signature has no second signatory without it.

fields.label: Primary Risk Category
fields.description: Single by definition — primary is singular.

fields.label: Owning Operating Group
fields.description: Single: organisational ownership is one accountable line. Core models the hierarchy as one Organization Unit tree; this must be a node at operating-group or corporate-support level.

fields.label: Owning Line of Business
fields.description: Single, same reason. Must sit under the owning operating group.

fields.label: Regulatory Requirements
fields.description: Required when the forum is regulatory-required (G-4).

fields.label: Parent Forum
fields.description: The single parent, for the hierarchy view. Distinct from the many-to-many forum links. A forum cannot be its own ancestor.

fields.label: Quorum Rule
fields.options:
Count
Percentage
All Voting Members
Chair Plus Count

fields.label: Quorum Value
fields.description: The count, or the percentage of entitled voters. Required for the count and percentage rules.

fields.label: Compliance Status
fields.options:
Draft
Pending
Compliant
Non-Compliant
Not Applicable
Disbanded
fields.description: The forum's workflow state. A label: every piece of logic reads the semantic flags below instead. Disbanded is the terminal state a controlled disbandment leaves behind — see the module README.

fields.label: Is Editable
fields.description: Semantic flag derived from Workflow State Flag.

fields.label: Is Active
fields.description: Semantic flag. False once disbanded; the record is never deleted.

fields.label: Requires Review
fields.description: Semantic flag. Set by the state map and by the watched-field hook.

fields.label: Formation Request
fields.description: Back-link to intake. Empty for forums loaded by migration.

fields.label: Next Review On
fields.description: The annual review due date (G-10).

fields.label: Last Attested On
fields.description: Denormalised from the latest completed attestation task.

fields.label: Retention Class
fields.description: Resolved from Retention Assignment; stored for reporting.

fields.label: Confidential
fields.description: Drives restricted handling. [Inferred — 02-data-model.md §6.2.]
